interrupt.ingress: MessageKind.INTERRUPT is claimed through the filtered durable coordination mailbox
interrupt.checkpoint: RuntimeCoordinator consumes the request at the existing cooperative Controller boundary
interrupt.child: one Core-owned interrupt child is created with an immutable InterruptFrame
interrupt.resume: maintenance resumes the parent only after the child reaches a terminal state
interrupt.capsule: ResumeCapsule push/pop is recorded as a bounded parent-resume projection
interrupt.duplicate_protection: repeated coordination delivery reuses the existing interrupt child

approval.runner: standard Discord runner injects a Core-owned approval view and submit callback
approval.authority: OperationService.submit_approval resolves the exact Controller checkpoint request
approval.persistence: approval records and decision events remain in the existing SQLite authority
approval.wake: approved waiting work is woken through the existing DurableQueue
approval.idempotency: approval event identity is scoped to the exact approval reference
approval.discord_authority: Discord buttons remain a thin authenticated input and do not own approval state

verification.credential_scan: no operator token or public secret value in tracked source, tests, docs, or evidence

limitations: This evidence verifies the local Core boundaries and standard-runner composition; it does not claim a real Discord client round trip.
A live test still requires a new Human message while the runner is online; Discord history backfill is not used.
The formal Phase 8 and D9 Production Deployment gates are unchanged.
